function s1(xs: Double[], ys: (Double | undefined)[]): Double {
  const v = xs[0]
  let sum = v * 2.0
  for (const w of ys) { const v = w; sum = sum + (v ?? 0.0) }
  return sum
}

function s3(xs: Double[]): string {
  const v = xs[0]
  let r = String(v * 2.0)
  try { r = r + 'x' } catch (v) { r = 'c' }
  for (let v = 0; v < 1; v++) { r = r + String(v) }
  return r
}
